About

Recovery, one step at a time.

I work with patients from their first assessment to their return to activity, with a special interest in sports and orthopaedic rehabilitation.

My clinical work covers sports injuries, recovery after surgery and neurological rehabilitation, along with paediatric and geriatric care. I treat patients in a rehab centre and in their own homes, including residential elderly care settings.

Every programme starts with a thorough assessment of strength, range of motion, balance, gait and how a person moves. From there I build a plan around their goals and adjust it at each reassessment.

Teaching is part of treatment. Patients and caregivers leave with home exercise programmes and a clear picture of how to protect their recovery. I also mentor junior physiotherapists and interns in assessment, treatment planning and clinical reasoning.

“Driven to bridge the gap between injury and peak performance through targeted rehab and patient education.”

Research

Two research projects.

Each one tests a practical, hands-on intervention for a specific group of patients.

Orthopaedics · BalanceIllustration

Weight-bearing exercise for balance and proprioception in knee osteoarthritis

A study of the effectiveness of static and dynamic weight-bearing exercises on balance and proprioception in people with osteoarthritis of the knee.

Population
Individuals with knee osteoarthritis
Intervention
Static and dynamic weight-bearing exercises
Outcomes
Balance and proprioception
Neurology · Oral motorIllustration

Facial massage and oral motor exercises for sialorrhea in Parkinson's disease

A study of the effectiveness of facial massage and oral motor exercises on sialorrhea, or excessive drooling, in people living with Parkinson's disease.

Population
Individuals with Parkinson's disease
Intervention
Facial massage and oral motor exercises
Outcome
Sialorrhea (excessive drooling)
